facts.fact: BVHTree.FromObject(obj, depsgraph) is built in the object's LOCAL space, from the evaluated mesh: a world-space ray misses or hits the wrong place
transforming the ray into local space (matrix_world.inverted()) gives the right hit; map it back with matrix_world

facts.doc: .. classmethod:: FromObject(object, depsgraph, deform=True, render=False, cage=False, epsilon=0.0)  BVH tree based on :class:`Object` data.

facts.fact: BVHTree.FromPolygons on world-space vertices (here: loop_triangles) answers world-space queries directly
ray_cast(origin, direction, distance) returns (None, None, None, None) when nothing is within distance
find_nearest from the centre returns a point at about radius 2 (scaled sphere)
find_nearest(point, distance) returns all None beyond distance
overlap() needs both trees in the same space: two FromObject trees (each local) find no overlap here, world-space trees do
KDTree of 100k points: build+balance 0.03 s, find() 0.5 us; find_n returns (co, index, dist) sorted by distance
querying a KDTree before balance() raises
facts.error: RuntimeError: KDTree must be balanced before calling find()
